scripts.speaker: Athena Sonotora
scripts.text:
They say the
famous dance school
here in Comodo is going
to open soon.

scripts.speaker: Athena Sonotora
scripts.text:
Aah...
To be a prima donna
in the spotlight!

scripts.speaker: Athena Sonotora
scripts.text:
I want to sign up too,
but the requirements are
so specific. I wonder if
I should just try anyways...

scripts.speaker: Bor Robin
scripts.text:
Aah....
A prima donna
in the spotlight!
I'll be able to watch them become Dancers right before my eyes...!

scripts.speaker: Bor Robin
scripts.text:
It's great to be
a man in this day and age! Hurray for the Comodo Theater!

scripts.speaker: Bor Robin
scripts.text:
Mm?
You want
to go, too?
It's a good opportunity to watch the Dancer job change test.
Go to the Job Change Area

scripts.speaker: Bor Robin
scripts.text:
Huh...
Well, I can't
help it if you don't
want to accompany me.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
One two three four,
Two two three four,
three four, three four,
one two three four.
Um?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you're interrupting my practice by looking at me funny.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Err...
That's weird, I can't remember where I've seen you.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welcome~!
Let me know
if you have any new songs. We can always use some new music to complement our performances.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welcome~!
How are you
these days?
Do many people enjoy
your performances?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, only authorized personnel can come here. Not just anyone can enter the Dance School.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: If you want to watch, why don't you go to the Dance Stage in town?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welcome~!
This is the
'Comodo Dance School,'
where we teach various dances from different countries. We provide entertainement for travelers from all over the world.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: We also provide the opportunity for aspiring Dancers to become famous throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Doesn't dancing in the spotlight sound spectacular?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: I think it's fair to let you know that our school is selective. So we don't accept students who don't seem to have the talent to become Dancers.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
What do you think?
Do you want to sign up? You only have to write a couple of things on the application, and you can just come to the lessons once or twice and try it out.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
So what do
you want to do~?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Good choice!!
Just fill out the application right there.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Your name is
{0}?
Wow! What a pretty name! Just a moment, I have to show this to the director, so come back in a little bit, okay?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Mmm...
It seems that
you aren't quite qualified to enroll in our school yet. You need to be at least Job Level 40.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Well, I hope
that you apply
again when you meet
the requirements.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Aww~
Just think about it.
Don't forget to come back
if you change your mind.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welco--Mmm?
Hey, this place is only for authorized personnel. If you want to sing, you should go look into being a Bard.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Not all Archers
can become Dancers.
At least, not without some sort of sex change~

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Good.
Since you signed up earlier, I'll let you know some things you'll need to bring for your lessons.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: We're short on some supplies, but you'll be using them for yourself anyway. Just think of it as part of the tuition, so don't worry too much.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, you'll about ^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000 for shoe polish.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: Then, bring ^CD68893 Jellopy^000000 and ^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 to use as ointment. And of course, you'll need a pair of ^CD6889Shoes^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Once again, that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000,
^CD68893 Jellopy^000000,
^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 and
^CD68891 Shoes^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 for polishing the floor and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Boots^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Once again that's
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 and 
^CD68891 Boots^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000 for your costume, ^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000 and ^CD688920 Jellopy^000000 to treat foot injuries.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: You'll also need to bring ^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 to make wigs for the performances and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Sandals^000000. Once again, that's...

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000,
^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000,
^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000,
^CD688920 Jellopy^000000,
^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 and
^CD6889Sandals^000000.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: Once you've gathered everything that you need, come back so that we can begin the lessons, okay?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Oh...!
You brought
everything!
Alright then,
let me take your
tuition fee.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: Next, go to ^CD6889Bijou^000000, who is in charge of the interviewing process. She will have a couple of things she'll need to ask you.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Mmm...?
You don't have
everything yet?
Let me remind you
so you can bring
what you need next time.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Are you having
trouble finding
^CD6889Bijou^000000?

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: You need to talk to her because she's in charge of the interviewing process. Don't worry, she should be somewhere here in the Dance School.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
I'll be looking
forward to a great
performance~

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text:
Welcom--Hm?
Hey, only authorized
personnel are allowed
in here.

scripts.speaker: Aile
scripts.text: If you want to watch, be quiet and don't disturb the performers. Everyone here is busy practicing so that they can become fine Dancers.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Welcome~
Ooh, a Bard! Do you have any new songs to show us? We can always use some musical accompaniment for our dances.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
How are you
these days?
A lot of people
must love watching
you dance. Are you
enjoying the spotlight?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh dear~
You seem to have traveled quite a distance to watch me perform.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I've retired. Now I'm focusing on training new Dancers. If you go to the Center Stage, you can watch my students~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: I know you're excited, but the first step is the application. Go over to the left side of the stage where Aile can help you with that.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh my~
You want to
become a Dancer,
don't you?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
G-goodness!
Look at that stomach fat!
Well, it's not much, so you'll lose it in no time. Especially since I'll be handling your training~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Still...
The idea of the
perfect body sure
has changed since
I was young. Anyway...

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Let's start
with the interview.
I'm only going to ask
a couple of simple things
so don't worry~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh, you're back~
Have you studied
some more? Try to
pass this time, okay?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
1. The Dancer's dance, ^CD6889Lady Luck^000000,
increases which of the following?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
2. Of the following,
which can you not consider
to be a dance?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
3. Which of the following
best describes a Dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
4. Which of the following
cannot be associated with Comodo?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: 5. Before Comodo, what is the region name of the region NorthEast of Pharoah's Lighthouse Island?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
6. Who is the most
beautiful dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
7. Of the following,
who can perform together
with a Dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
8. Which of the following
is not a specialty of Comodo?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
9. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
10. Who accepts the
Dancer job change
applications?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
1. What is the effect
of the combined skill,
^CD6889Mental Sensing^000000?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
2. Which is considered
bad etiquette on the dance
floor after a dance?
Ask to dance a different dance.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
3. Which is not an
appropriate response
when someone makes
a mistake while you
are dancing together?
Smile at each other and continue dancing.
Ignore it if the dancer does not realize it.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
4. In which town
can you change jobs
to a Dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
5. How many dungeons
are directly connected
to Comodo?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
6. Which of the following
is not a Cute Pet monster?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
7. Who is the most
graceful dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
8. What is the
exact name of the
Kafra in Comodo?
Casts the Blind effect in the area.
Casts the Sleep effect on the area.
Puts a night effect on the area.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
1. What is the effect
of the skill ^CD6889Dance Lessons^000000?
Increases the effect of dancing skills
Inflict Stun on a certain area around the caster.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
2. What dance uses shoes
that are designed to make
sound as the dancer rolls
their feet and taps the
ground to create a rhythm?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
3. Which of the following
is not a characteristic of a Dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
4. Which town has
the most Dancers?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
5. Of the following,
who dances most beautifully?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
...
That's...
^660000completely wrong^000000.
Didn't you see the
other choices?!
Minus points...!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
6. What is the Dancer
better at than the other
job classes?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
7. Who is the manager
of the Comodo Casino?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
8. What item cannot
be equipped by a Dancer?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
9. Do you think you
can say this quiz is
frustrating and annoying?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
10. Which of the following
is not a Jazz musician?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Good job~
It seems like you
answered all the
questions~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
Very well done!
A perfect score!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
It wasn't perfect, but I'll let you pass.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Let's see...
Your score is
{0} points...
You.. You failed!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: There aren't too many people who apply for the Dancer job with this kind of knowledge. I'm sorry for judging you by your looks~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Whew~
Now you only have the Dance Test. While we prepare the test, why don't you rest a bit? Ho ho ho~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Was it too hard?
When I was young, everyone knew at least enough to pass this test. Go and study some more before coming back, okay?

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Okay...
Are you ready
for the Dance Test?
If you like, I can
explain the instructions.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: First of all, each person gets ^CD68891 minute^000000 for the test, and everyone dances ^CD6889one at a time^000000. Don't worry if you've never danced before~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Once you enter the testing area, you will see the stage. First, ^CD6889change your camera angle so that it faces forward^000000. It will probably work if you ^CD6889double-click on the right mouse button^000000.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: If you don't reset your camera angle, you may get the ^CD6889Up, Down, Left, Right^000000 commands confused.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Wait for your turn in the ^CD6889waiting room^000000. If the person in front of you fails, or if it's your turn in line, your test will begin.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: If there are a lot of people, not everyone might fit in the waiting room. If that's the case, just create an orderly line~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: When the test begins, the music will be broadcast, as well as the direction in which you should move. Just follow the instructions and move your legs.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Remember, ^CD6889you will be disqualified if you don't perform the steps with the right timing^000000. Be careful, the test is very strict~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh my...
Did you
fail last time?
Don't worry, just
try to feel the rhythm~

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
You can't change jobs
if you still have skill
points left. Use the rest
and come back later.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Oh my...
I saw your
dance earlier.
You were great!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: Your performance shows that you are than qualified to become a Dancer. Well then, let me change your job.

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text: With the blessing of our goddess, you shall be reborn as a Dancer. From now on, no one will leave your presense without a smile~

Ooh...!
You look great
as a Dancer~
Congratulations!

scripts.speaker: Bijou
scripts.text:
Here's a small
gift from me.
Please take it.
May your performances always bring joy to your audience~

scripts.speaker: Pyorgin
scripts.text:
Please wait in
the waiting room.
Click the Chatroom
box to enter.

scripts.speaker: Pyorgin
scripts.text:
Also, those who
are curious about
the test can watch
backstage.
